end.line: Quillon for Devereux Partners’ restructuring team

vo: Devereux Partners runs fifteen live restructuring cases, comparing intercreditor agreements under time pressure.
Ask where a creditor ranks, and the answer comes back cited to the page of each intercreditor agreement.
Quillon builds the case chronology from the exhibits, and every event links back to its source document.
In Word, the amendment to the credit agreement is redlined to your playbook, with each change explained beside it.
Marc will walk your team through it on Wednesday the eighteenth.
